Akash and Maya, two doctors, are happily married and expecting a baby. However, things take a turn when Maya's bus crashes, and she is believed to be dead.
Kabir, an alcoholic lawyer, falls in love with Sonia, the wife of a travelling millionaire, who convinces him to murder her husband. Later, Kabir is shocked to learn of her motivation for the murder.

A money-minded tycoon gets into a beneficial relationship with a woman. Soon, he learns about the differences in his family and decides to end them.
Some thugs annihilate an entire family and flee the scene without facing any consequences. Years later, the universe balances the scales of justice through the sole survivor of the tragedy.
Muskaan, an unpopular, shy girl, falls for Dino, a charismatic dancer, while on a vacation in Goa with her family. However, things become complicated when her father objects to their relationship.
Suffering from memory loss every 15 minutes, a heartbroken man uses photographs, notes and tattoos to keep reminding himself to punish his lady-love's murderer.
Angoori tracks Vibhuti and Tika after spotting them together, leading her to suspect a second wife. Tiwari investigates the claims and captures both men on his mobile phone.
Anita gets upset after Tiwari shows her pictures of Vibhuti and Tika. She then convinces Tiwari to bring Prem along to pose as her second spouse.
Anita rehearses a play with Prem to make her husband jealous, leading Angoori to misinterpret their actions. Vibhuti eventually uncovers the plan and exposes the truth to all.
Vibhuti, Tiwari and Prem gamble with Madam Noori at a hotel club and lose everything. Later, she forces them to work as waiters before Saxena arrives with Dr Gupta.
Tiwari and Vibhuti disguise themselves in a panic upon hearing that their wives have arrived at the hotel. They assist with the luggage while Tika and his friends show up at the venue.
Tiwari and Vibhuti disguise themselves as men to flirt with their wives. Saxena poses as a wealthy Sheikh and demands that Teeka and his friends live like camels.
Angoori and Anita discover the situation and decide to tease their husbands. Meanwhile, Saxena orders Teeka and his group to perform a camel dance.
Anita and Angoori learn of the dire situation and gamble against Noorie to win back their husbands. Elsewhere, Teeka and his group realize that Saxena was posing as the wealthy Sheikh.
Anita accuses Vibhuti of being insensitive, causing his blood pressure to soar. Dr Gupta advises everyone to keep him calm, prompting Tiwari to act overly sensitive.
Anita shouts at Vibhuti; in turn, he pretends to be sick; Tiwari is behaving emotionally.
Angoori speaks her heart out in front of Anita about her fight with Tiwari. On the other hand, Vibhuti tries to rub salt in Tiwari's wounds.
Vibhuti Narayan Mishra and Manmohan Tiwari live in the same neighbourhood in Kanpur. They both try to impress each other's wives but end up landing in peculiar situations.
Anita learns Vibhuti lies to Prem about his elaborate deception. Consequently, she feigns departure and leaves a missive.
Manmohan is a businessman with a traditional wife. Narayan is jobless with a modern wife. Both try impressing each other's spouses, creating hilarious chaos, lies, and comic situations.
Stand-up comedians aka 'Mahabalis' deliver performances of hilarious and satirical skits with the help of their battalion of 'Yoddhas'.
Under the influence of Rajjo, Beni replaces the branded liquor with a cheap one. Later, a scared Beni suspects that he might get exposed.
While Vibhuti and Tiwari's vacation plans backfire due to blackmail, Anita and Angoori retrieve the video from Pammi, yet they confront their husbands as Happu arrests the blackmailer.
Disguised as "Meow Girl," Anita beats up goons and later punishes Manmohan for abusing Angoori on a priest's advice. Meanwhile, Vibhuti falsely suspects Anita of cheating on him.
While Manmohan falsely blames Angoori for an attack, Vibhuti suspects Anita of cheating with the commissioner. Meanwhile, a furious Anita crashes a dance gathering and beats up the men.
After Happu overhears a conversation, he fuels Vibhuti's suspicions regarding Anita. Meanwhile, the Meow Girl beats Manmohan before Anokhelal attempts to befriend her.
Gulfam delivers a captivating dance performance. Meanwhile, the Meow Girl scratches the men before lashing Manmohan, who misinterprets the attack.
Vibhuti finds a gold coin while helping Angoori fulfil a vow at a crossroads. Meanwhile, the visionary Achanaklal informs Vibhuti that a vast treasure is hidden beneath Tiwari's house.
The Tiwaris temporarily move in with the Mishras, where Vibhuti gives them spiked milk. While Manmohan is caught trying to ogle a sleeping Anita, Teeka, Malkhan, and Tillu dig up the Tiwari house.
A prophecy about a hidden treasure leads several neighbors to dig up the local roads. Anita and Vibhuti eventually expose the entire truth to the confused residents.
Upon discovering reality, the physician aids the diggers. Meanwhile, the crew demands that arrogant manager Vibhuti excavate alongside them.
Vibhuti aims to prove his earning potential by delivering supplies to Saxena's friends. Later, Anita confronts Tiwari after he ruins the cash payment Vibhuti receives for completing the job.
Anita orders Vibhuti to handle domestic chores, leading Tiwari to suggest that he move to London. Meanwhile, Anita decides to boycott Chhedi after discovering his wife's poor hygiene habits.
Tiwari loses his temper with Vibhuti over poorly washed laundry, whilst Anita bans Vibhuti from using the home toilet. Meanwhile, Happu arrests a group of locals during a new cleanliness drive.
Anita and Angoori use Collector Jain to fight public defecation, catching Teeka, Malkhan, and Happu. Later, Manmohan calms Angoori about a plait cutter who has already targeted Gulfam and Rajesh.
Per Gaaleeyanand's orders, Vibhuti and Manmohan try to sneakily cut the other's wife's hair at midnight. After escaping a close call, both lie about why they are out. Later, Angoori stops Vibhuti.
Galiyanand offers Vibhuti and Tiwari a new plan, whilst Anita and Angoori try to trap a local criminal. Meanwhile, confusion arises when both parties find their targets missing during the night.
Anita's praise for Anurag irks Vibhuti and Manmohan. Meanwhile, after an unpaid Tillu curses Manmohan and offers to work as a guard, Vibhuti opens a security agency where Anokhelal seeks work.
Anita eventually decides to support Vibhuti's security agency. However, she is reluctantly forced to accommodate Teeka, Tillu and Malkhan at the Mishra residence.
Legendary phantoms ensnare Himanshu within a palace during a recording. Consequently, Mahek and residents attempt a rescue.
Roshni unwittingly gifts her brother a bottle holding Julekha, who traps him for revenge before Roshni learns her secret.
A young Lord Shiva shares a deep bond with his mother, Mahasati Anusuya, and goes on various adventures and vanquishes evil.
Kali changes back to her Parvati avatar at the sight of a crying Baal Shiva. Later, Anusuya is commanded by Parvati to let go of the Tridevs from her bond.
Anasuya, wife of Sage Atri, is tested by gods. They turn into babies, but Anasuya turns Shiva into a baby. The show focuses on her motherhood.
Pandu, Kunti and Madri leave Hastinapur as Dhritarashtra takes the throne. Later, Dhritarashtra reveals that he is suspicious of Gandhari.

A runaway bride, Madhavi, makes a solemn vow to her dying widowed friend, Poonam, to look after the upbringing of her child.
Raja disappears in a railway accident, leaving his parents Manoharlal and Shanti heartbroken. Fate intervenes when an elephant saves the boy and delivers him to a colourful circus life.
Chaos ensues when Vikram and Anand, two best friends who are raised as brothers, happen to fall in love with the same woman.
During a journey, Kedarnath Bhargav, his wife, Laxmi, and two sons, Ram and Lakshman, get separated and subsequently, they all lead different lives.
Accompanied by a troubled trio of prisoners, a high-ranking law enforcement officer sets out to avenge the miseries inflicted upon his family by an anti-national group.
Brothers Raju and Shankar, who are separated by fate, cross paths with each other in Mumbai when Kamini, a wealthy runaway, unintentionally barges into their lives.
When all the family property is left to Bharat, his brother wants to kill him for the wealth. Bharat overhears his plan and plays along only to return as a dacoit to set things right.

A young and ambitious New York City matchmaker finds herself torn between a seemingly perfect match and her imperfect ex-boyfriend.

Agent J of the Men in Black goes back in time to prevent the assassination of his partner, Agent K, at the hands of an alien criminal named Boris the Animal.
A lawyer from the US military safeguards two US marines who are charged for killing a fellow marine and a colonel turns into the prime suspect.
Peter Parker tries to stop the Vulture from selling weapons made with advanced Chitauri technology while trying to balance his life as an ordinary high school student.
Li Fong, a karate prodigy, moves to NYC and attracts the ire of the local champion. Later, he seeks out the help of Mr Han and Daniel LaRusso to enter and win the ultimate karate tournament.

Avani, a resolute young woman, prepares for her wedding, giving up her ambitions. However, a startling turn of events transforms her life when she meets Dhanraj.
Unaware of her true identity, Yamini lives a quiet life until fate draws her back to her birthplace, unravelling a dark past filled with love and vengeance.
The Randives, a close-knit family, face challenges as outsiders try to divide them. Will their strong bonds overcome the conspiracy threatening their unity?
Strict patriarch Shivnath restricts his children regarding love and marriage because he fears family fragmentation. Consequently, the youths rebel.
